about:
B J Plastic Molding Co Inc has operated from Franklin Park, Illinois since its founding in 1968. With over 50 years of experience, the company manufactures rigid plastic boxes and containers entirely within its own U.S. facilities.

The company specializes in injection molding of rigid plastic boxes and containers, offering more than 130 stock sizes in single or two-tone colors. Services include custom imprinting, hot stamping, pad printing (including UPC bar codes), die cutting for information cards that extend through the box hinges, and on-site color and process consultation. All products are designed, created, manufactured, and decorated in the United States.

The company serves customers who need rigid plastic packaging for retail display, offering boxes that allow products to be shown on racks without blister packaging. Its reusable and recyclable boxes are positioned as an alternative to single-use clamshells, providing a container the consumer can keep after the product is used.

B J Plastic Molding emphasizes domestic manufacturing, with all operations performed in-house at its Illinois facility. The company holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and highlights its reusable, recyclable boxes as an alternative to single-use blister packs.
